description: This file defines the Select class, a query builder for SQL SELECT statements within Drupal's database abstraction layer. It includes methods for constructing, compiling, and executing complex SQL queries with joins, conditions, unions, and other clauses.

classes.name: Select
classes.description: A class for building and executing SQL SELECT queries, supporting joins, conditions, unions, and various SQL clauses within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Select object with database connection, table or subquery, alias, and options.

methods.name: addTag
methods.description: Adds a tag to the query for later identification or alteration.

methods.name: hasTag
methods.description: Checks if a specific tag is present on the query.

methods.name: hasAllTags
methods.description: Checks if all specified tags are present.

methods.name: hasAnyTag
methods.description: Checks if any of the specified tags are present.

methods.name: addMetaData
methods.description: Adds metadata to the query for internal use.

methods.name: getMetaData
methods.description: Retrieves metadata associated with a specific key.

methods.name: arguments
methods.description: Returns the arguments for the query, compiling if necessary.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the query into SQL, preparing all parts for execution.

methods.name: compiled
methods.description: Checks if the query has been fully compiled.

methods.name: havingCondition
methods.description: Adds a condition to the HAVING clause.

methods.name: havingConditions
methods.description: Returns the conditions in the HAVING clause.

methods.name: havingArguments
methods.description: Returns arguments for the HAVING clause.

methods.name: having
methods.description: Adds a raw condition snippet to the HAVING clause.

methods.name: havingCompile
methods.description: Compiles the HAVING clause.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Extends the query with a driver-specific class.

methods.name: havingIsNull
methods.description: Adds an IS NULL condition to HAVING.

methods.name: havingIsNotNull
methods.description: Adds an IS NOT NULL condition to HAVING.

methods.name: havingExists
methods.description: Adds an EXISTS condition to HAVING.

methods.name: havingNotExists
methods.description: Adds a NOT EXISTS condition to HAVING.

methods.name: forUpdate
methods.description: Sets the FOR UPDATE flag for the query.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the list of selected fields.

methods.name: getExpressions
methods.description: Returns the list of expressions.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Returns the order by clauses.

methods.name: getGroupBy
methods.description: Returns the group by clauses.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: Returns the list of tables involved in the query.

methods.name: getUnion
methods.description: Returns the list of union queries.

methods.name: escapeLike
methods.description: Escapes a string for LIKE clause.

methods.name: escapeField
methods.description: Escapes a field name.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns the query arguments, compiling if needed.

methods.name: isPrepared
methods.description: Checks if preExecute() has been called.

methods.name: preExecute
methods.description: Prepares the query for execution, allowing modules to alter it.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the query and returns the result.

methods.name: distinct
methods.description: Sets whether the query should be DISTINCT.

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Adds a field to the SELECT clause.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Specifies fields to select from a table.

methods.name: addExpression
methods.description: Adds an expression to the SELECT clause.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Adds an INNER JOIN.

methods.name: innerJoin
methods.description: Adds an INNER JOIN.

methods.name: leftJoin
methods.description: Adds a LEFT OUTER JOIN.

methods.name: addJoin
methods.description: Adds a join of specified type.

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Adds an ORDER BY clause.

methods.name: orderRandom
methods.description: Orders results randomly.

methods.name: range
methods.description: Sets LIMIT and OFFSET.

methods.name: union
methods.description: Adds a UNION query.

methods.name: groupBy
methods.description: Adds a GROUP BY clause.

methods.name: countQuery
methods.description: Creates a COUNT(*) query based on current query.

methods.name: prepareCountQuery
methods.description: Prepares a count query from the current query.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the query to its SQL string representation.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Clones the query object, including dependent objects.
